versions.changelog: Update display name to opencli zh

Tone down capability-trigger terms by replacing explicit Bearer/CSRF and signature wording with neutral session/request-header/request-validation language, while preserving the actual workflow boundaries.
Add explicit metadata for opencli install/config paths and tighten consent boundaries for browser-state access, extension changes, and persistent ~/.opencli writes.
Initial publish of opencli-zh with zh guidance, mtime support, and custom-adapter workflows.
